# Sla Monitor Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills

## Overview

Use when monitoring SLA/SLO adherence, tracking error budgets, alerting on burn rate, or reporting reliability metrics.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [sla-monitor-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
sla-monitor-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@sla-monitor` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze cloud spending across services, teams, and environments
- Identify cost optimization opportunities: idle resources, over-provisioning, licensing waste
- Model ROI scenarios for technology investments and migrations
- Track budget utilization with alerting on threshold breaches

## Industry Standards Applied

- **IEEE 730**: Software quality assurance processes and standards
- **ISO 25010**: Software quality model: functional suitability, reliability, maintainability
